aboutMe.text: I am a fullstack developer from Wilhering near Linz, building native apps, web apps and websites – from the interface through the API to the database, for companies in Upper Austria and remotely. At Pulsify I maintain the native app, the dashboard and the Hono backend. Alongside that I am building my own products under the byButterfly brand, from product analysis to the finished app. Before that, nine years in specialist retail with daily customer contact: I know how people search, what they really need and where they get stuck – and that goes into every interface and API I build. What counts for me is not the latest technology but the solution behind it: well thought out, user-friendly and still maintainable years later. I calculate costs realistically: it is not the cheapest developer hour that sets the price, but what gets done in that hour. That is how products are built that are a win for both sides: real value for the users, measurable benefit for the company.
aboutMe.collaborate: I look forward to creating something great together!

skills.introduction: Expertise from many completed projects, practical knowledge from everyday work with real users. I keep developing this stack so that software stays affordable to build without cutting corners on quality.

projects.text: An excerpt of my work: native apps, web apps, websites and backends, developed in Linz.

pulsify.descText: Planning app for going out: events and places in Austria's cities. One sentence is enough, Pulsify AI turns it into a plan with its own chat. Web app, iOS and Android app plus a business dashboard for venues and organizers. Startup project, I work on the whole monorepo.
pulsify.implementText: One monorepo, one API contract: the Hono backend defines every route with Zod schemas, the Expo app and the Vite dashboard call it through a typed RPC client. A changed endpoint breaks the consumers at compile time, not in production. Supabase provides auth, Postgres and storage; only the backend talks to the database and owns the business logic. Each app deploys on its own: Railway, Vercel and EAS.

join.descText: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories. Frontend only.
join.implementText: Kanban board as a single-page app in plain JavaScript. Firebase is the only backend: tasks, contacts and users live as JSON documents, the client reads and writes them over the REST interface and re-renders the affected column. Drag and drop changes only the status field, everything else stays untouched. Design built from the Figma template, responsive down to the phone.

elpolloloco.descText: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen. Two difficult levels, an endless Chicken Rush mode and a top 30 Highscore board.
elpolloloco.implementText: A canvas game on an object-oriented core. One base class draws, animates and moves; characters, enemies and items inherit from it and add their own logic. A central loop checks collisions and drives the animations, a sound object controls all volume in one place. The high score board is the only external dependency: a small REST API that the game reads and writes.

videoflix.descText: Backend for a small video streaming platform. Users register by e-mail, activate their account via mail, log in with JWT cookies and stream videos as HLS in 480p, 720p and 1080p. Backend only, see the repository.
videoflix.implementText: Django REST Framework with Simple JWT in HttpOnly cookies, account activation and password reset by mail. PostgreSQL as database, Redis with django-rq for background jobs: every upload triggers ffmpeg jobs that transcode the video into HLS playlists per resolution. Mails go through the queue as well. Everything in Docker Compose with an entrypoint for migrations, worker and gunicorn. Tests for auth and content endpoints.

coderr.descText: Full stack platform for IT services. Business users publish offers with three packages, customers order them and rate the provider afterwards. Full stack project, ready to test live. Hosted on my own netcup server.
coderr.implementText: Django REST Framework API against a given specification. Token auth with registration and login, two roles with object level permissions. Nested serializers for offers and packages, orders that copy the conditions, reviews once per provider. Filtering, search, ordering, pagination and rate limiting. Integration tests for the happy path and the error cases. Docker with gunicorn behind nginx on a Linux vServer I set up myself.
